quarterly_data.quarter: IREN press release: IREN to Advance Europe's Sovereign AI Ambitions with 300MW (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IREN established IREN Europe and secured the civil works license and grid-connected power for its planned AI data center campus in Badajoz, Extremadura, Spain: approximately 300MW of capacity, initial operations targeted for 2028, designed around closed-loop liquid cooling and for compatibility with the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform. IREN plans to offer AI cloud services from Badajoz, including managed services, to customers with European data-residency requirements, using the software capabilities of Mirantis (acquisition completed), including k0rdent AI, which integrates NVIDIA Infra Controller and NVIDIA Run:ai. Co-CEO Daniel Roberts: Badajoz is the first project in Europe. The campus is part of IREN's announced portfolio of more than 5GW of grid-connected power across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific; IREN entered Europe in June 2026 with the acquisition of Spain-based data center developer Nostrum Group and its team of more than 60.
